framework_notes: This is a static HTML route with file-based routing, plain CSS, and no demonstrated build tool or component framework.
Existing inline HTML implements the required UI slots semantically; separate generated components are unnecessary.
Use standard anchors and images, retaining existing site.css conventions rather than introducing React, JSX, Next.js, or another framework.
Browsers cannot consume TypeScript support modules directly. Any such modules require an explicit generation-time consumer.

The selected static_markdown adapter advertises frontmatter support but does not support index or detail shells. Its declared availability does not establish that it can regenerate stories/index.html.
The supplied head metadata corrects the current audit's missing seo_metadata finding; the existing containers and grid likewise correct its missing directory_container and article_list findings.

details: Check for an existing authoritative article metadata source before creating a duplicate.
If none exists, create a static-compatible registry and migrate metadata for the featured story and all 35 grid entries.
Follow the ArticleRecord contract, preserving titles, descriptions, dates, categories, images, featured status, and existing destinations.
Verify content files and author information before assigning contentPath, hasContent, author keys, or editorial metadata; do not invent unavailable values.
Reconcile the configured stories/registry.ts path with the static/frontmatter adapter. JSON is a proposed compatible alternative, not an existing file.
Make the registry the metadata source for generating the featured story and listing markup.
Use an explicit generation-time integration that emits deployable HTML; an unused support file is not sufficient.
Preserve the existing hero, containers, story-grid, story-card, story-featured, metadata, and target-site styling.
Keep index generation metadata-only rather than importing article bodies.
If the selected adapter cannot patch HTML shells, provide a compatible deterministic generation step or require manual adapter work instead of assuming shell support.
Verify registry-to-output parity and unique records.
Check article destinations and image assets without assuming supplied links resolve.
Preserve the featured article's legacy destination unless a verified migration and redirect are supplied.
Confirm directory URL normalization to /stories/ so relative links resolve correctly.
Verify that existing heading, listing, links, and head metadata remain intact.
The current grid has 35 entries, exceeding the surface plan's page size of 24.
For growth to hundreds of articles, generate paginated HTML with ordinary navigation links and page-specific metadata.
Pagination is not required to recognize the existing article_list slot.
